svg.text: Email-driven orchestration for a flock of headless Claude workers
You email a task or a reply — a worker emails you back its plan, milestones and result.
Spawn a worker, keep it alive, and steer it mid-task by email.
A long job sleeps cheaply and is woken the instant it finishes.
Watch the whole colony in a read-only web dashboard.
Each worker runs in the foreground, start to finish.
